cli.locale: language of help text and diagnostics (default: $FULLMT_LOCALE, else en-US); codes, statuses and rule ids are never translated
cli.log_level: diagnostic level on stderr (default: $FULLMT_LOG_LEVEL, else WARNING)
cli.reader.description: FULLMT package reader: verify one BOOMVALLEY Lab package directory (historical EPC: EVIDENCE.json; current: MANIFEST-4.json)
cli.reader.package: package directory (EVIDENCE.json or MANIFEST-4.json at its root)
cli.smoke.out: output directory for verification.json, tamper/ and e2e_summary.json
cli.smoke.package: BVL EPC package (default: $BVL_EPC_PACKAGE, else the BVL canonical package)
error.AMBIGUOUS_PACKAGE_FORMAT: The package root holds both EVIDENCE.json and MANIFEST-4.json; the package format is ambiguous.
error.CONSUMER_RUNTIME_ERROR: The reader hit a runtime limit (recursion or memory) while consuming the package.
error.INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected internal error in FULLMT (a defect, not a verdict).
error.IO_ERROR: A file could not be read or written.
error.JSON_PARSE_ERROR: The package manifest (EVIDENCE.json or MANIFEST-4.json) is not strict JSON.
error.MANIFEST_NOT_READABLE: MANIFEST-4.json is present but is not a readable regular file.
error.NOT_AN_EPC_PACKAGE: The directory is not a package this reader handles (no readable EVIDENCE.json object and no MANIFEST-4.json).
error.OUTPUT_WRITE_ERROR: The result file could not be written.
error.PACKAGE_NOT_A_DIRECTORY: The package path is not a directory.
error.PACKAGE_ROOT_IS_A_LINK: The package root is a link or reparse point.
error.PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission denied while reading the package.
error.UNSUPPORTED_ELIGIBILITY_SCHEMA: The eligibility report schema is not supported by this reader.
error.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: The canonical format or digest algorithm is not supported by this reader.
error.UNSUPPORTED_GNDCRW_VERSION: The GNDCRW version is not supported by this reader.
error.UNSUPPORTED_IDENTITY_VERSION: An identity version is not supported by this reader.
error.UNSUPPORTED_MANIFEST_SCHEMA: The manifest schema is not supported by this reader.
